companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: CAMINUS (formerly EnPower, Inc.) is an Indianapolis-based lithium-ion cell manufacturer building end-to-end, domestic, NDAA-compliant battery capacity for defense, autonomy, and critical infrastructure markets. From our 90,000+ sqft facility, we operate two production-scale electrode coating lines paired with expanding automated cell assembly lines, making us one of the few U.S. companies with true powder-to-cell capability under one roof. jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: Responsible for leading process development, optimization and scale-up activities for the manufacturing of li-ion cells and their upstream sub-assemblies. Lead planning and installation of new manufacturing equipment and qualification processes. Maps, documents, and analyzes existing processes to understand current workflows, identify inefficiencies, and provide actionable insights for optimization which allows for efficiency, quality, scalability, and waste reduction.
